schema: DS(H,v) for every adapted admissible v of length six and depth four with conjugation-odd product parity. This is one complete left-letter schema, not every weight-seven relation.
scope: Each row is a linear combination of standard convergent or one-divergence double-shuffle rows, then projected by the proved full-Cayley retraction. A nonzero pairing is meaningful as a bounded-span escape only when the projected row lies in F4. Zero extension outside F4 is labeled only as a diagnostic. This finite schema does not prove S6, nonmembership in the full higher-depth family, or numerical period independence.
record_format: projected_relation is a list of [word, rational coefficient] pairs; no coefficient is dropped.
